It hurts a lot. 

Fuck. 

Deep red

§5My§0 knees hit the floor so abruptly, the shock of the impact radiates

up §5my§0 body. 

But §5I§0 can barely

 §5I§0 can barely feel anything right now, except a deep need to rest §5my§0 eyes. 

§5I§0 begin moving to lay on the ground, curled up and woozy, but §5my§0 head meets nothing.

§5My§0 shoulder, §5my§0 side, no part of §5me§0 meets anything. 


§5I§0 am in free fall. 

§5I§0 hurtle into

Falling down and down forever and ever into §5who§0 knows what, the air around §5me§0 is so

§5I§0 have no energy to think about where §5I’m§0 going or why §5I’m§0 going or when §5I’m§0 going. 

§5I’m§0 not afraid. 

§5I§0 don’t feel any kind of emotion. §5I§0 don’t really feel anything but the rush of air

of air flowing

How long has 
it been here? 

It feels like it’s been hours, or maybe days. 
§5I§0 might have fallen asleep at some point. 

Drifting in and out of consciousness as §5I§0

plummet towards whatever sits at the bottom, and suddenly §5I’m§0 bolting out of bed.

Where the fuck am §5I§0?

§5My§0 fall stops unexpectedly.

§5I§0 don’t remember hitting anything. 

§5I§0 don’t feel the pain

of hitting the ground like §5I§0 should have. 

§5I’m§0 laying in a bed, sitting up, panting. 

§5I§0 look around 
the room §5I’m§0 in. 

The room is nearly pitch black, with little more than the faintest light showering its features.

A closed window on one wall, a door on another. 

No blacket, 
nor cover 
on the bed §5I’m§0 on. 

Just an exposed mattress top sitting in a wooden frame. 

§5I§0 pull up §5my§0 sleeves and look §5my§0 arms

over. They bear none of the cuts that §5my§0 message to §1Oliver§0 left. 
What the hell 
is going on? 

Was this all some horrifically detailed nightmare? 

§5I§0 start to stand up, turning §5myself§0 to get off the bed.

§5I§0 inspect underneath the bed, but find nothing. 

§5I§0 look at the floor more closely, and find that all too familiar wood grain floor. 

§5I’m§0 still in the §2Library§0. 
§5I§0 slam §5my§0 fist 
into the floor.

God fucking damnit. 

The pain and shock of the slam echoes and reverberates inside §5my§0 body. 

It hurts, but 
§5I§0 barely notice it. 

§5I§0 slam §5my§0 fist into the ground again. 

And again.

As if punching the floor could somehow break it open and let §5me§0 out of the hell hole. 

§5I§0 think §5I§0 broke

The pain is excruciating. 

No point in crying about it though, §5I’ve

only got §5myself§0 to blame. 

§5I§0 did this

Cradling §5my§0 injured hand, §5I§0 begin standing back up. 

§5I§0 study the room §5I’m§0 in a bit more, drinking in every detail §5I§0 can in the ultra low light.

Despite hardly being able to see anything, §5I§0 can make out a number of details. 

For starters, the bed is the only thing in the room. 

Besides that, 
there’s nothing. 

No lamp, no light bulb, no drawers, no closet,

not even a light switch on the wall. 

Speaking of the walls, it’s decorated. 

Instead of the usual shelves of books, the walls are what you’d expect from a standard bedroom.

Smooth, painted walls. Where the hell have §5I

ended up? 

§5I§0 move to the door. 

Grabbing the knob and twisting reveals that the door feels stuck on something. 

Not locked, but more like it’s jammed up. 

Rattling the knob a bit and really forcing it

does nothing. 

§5I§0 start to panic a bit. 

§5I’ve§0 been here for how long, and §5I’m§0 already trapped? 

Are you kidding §5me§0? 

No, fuck that. 

§5I’m§0 not going to be stuck here.

Eat shit. 

Sorry to §5who§0ever owns this place, if there’s even an owner. 

§5I§0 step back, and brace §5my§0 legs to open the door by force. 

It didn’t feel particularly sturdy, so §5I’m§0 confident §5I§0 can

simply tear it down §5myself§0. 

§5My§0 hip twists upwards, and §5I§0 prepare a devastating blow to the door, when it suddenly opens on its own. 

§5I’m§0 so taken aback that §5I§0 thrust §5my§0 leg forwards anyways, hitting the door just

before it's clear, and sending it into the wall with a loud §lSLAM! §0

Why did the 
door open? 

There’s no way it did that on its own. 

It definitely wasn’t locked, because what kind of door would lock from the §o§noutside?

But then that means something was blocking it, and then suddenly stopped blocking it.

Something must 
be in here with §5me§0. 

The realization that there might be something else in…wherever the 
hell this is puts 
§5me§0 on edge.

§5I§0 am in a completely unfamiliar environment. 
Combined with the fact that §5I’m§0 completely unarmed, and can’t even see here. 

The hallway beyond the room §5I’m§0 in is somehow slightly more illuminated than the room itself, but it’s still nearly impossible

to see. 

There’s two doors on the left side, a door at the end of the hall, and a staircase going down on the right side. 
Where the hell is this light even coming from?
